tagline: Research with Confidence. Report with Clarity.
heroTitle: Research you can verify. Reports you can trust.
heroBody: Check claims, explore evidence, and turn questions or documents into clear, source-linked research reports.
heroNote: 3 free reports per month · No sign-up needed
formBody: Describe what you want to understand. Add details in Advanced options if you need a more focused report.
promptPlaceholder: What would you like to research?
ex1: Is remote work linked to higher productivity?
ex2: Market overview of plant-based milk in Europe
ex3: Fact-check: humans only use 10% of their brains
uploadHint: .txt, .md, .csv, .docx or .pdf, up to 5 MB. The text is added to your question.
uploadError: Only .txt, .md, .csv, .docx or .pdf files up to 5 MB are supported.
generating: Writing your report. This usually takes 20–60 seconds…
limit: You've used this month's free reports. They reset on the 1st of next month.
aiLabel: AI-generated analysis. Review the sources before relying on it.
noWeb: VerifAI does not browse the live web. Sources come from the AI model's training knowledge and may be outdated or incomplete. Always open and check them.
sampleBadge: Illustrative example: placeholder content, not real research
sampleTopic: Example topic: Does daily coffee affect sleep quality?
sampleSummary: This area shows a short overview of the answer, the strength of the evidence, and what remains uncertain.
sampleFinding: Each finding is a clear statement tied to specific claims and sources below.
sampleClaim: Example claim with its evidence status and the sources that support or dispute it.
how1Body: Submit a research question or a short text document.
how2Body: The AI model draws on what it knows about the topic and relevant sources.
how3Body: Individual claims are compared and marked supported, disputed, or unverified.
how4Body: Receive a report with findings, cited sources, limitations, and method.
howNote: AI analysis can be wrong. VerifAI helps you check claims; it does not guarantee truth.
f1Body: Structured answers to open questions in under a minute.
f2Body: Each claim is labelled supported, disputed, or unverified.
f3Body: Cited sources with publisher and year so you can check them.
f4Body: Add text from your own notes or briefs to focus the report.
f5Body: Generate reports in the language you work in.
f6Body: Copy, download as Markdown, or print to PDF.
evBody: Every report separates what the evidence says from the AI's own synthesis, and says where it is unsure.
evSupported: Several credible sources agree and none contradict the claim.
evDisputed: Credible sources disagree, or the evidence points in different directions.
evUnverified: Not enough reliable evidence was found to judge the claim.
evNote: These labels are the AI's assessment, not proof. Source links and dates may be wrong, so open them before you cite them.
uc1Body: Get a structured starting point and sources to read next.
uc2Body: Scan a topic's claims and debates before a deeper review.
uc3Body: Sort claims into supported, disputed, and unverified.
uc4Body: Draft market and competitor overviews quickly.
uc5Body: Prepare client briefs with clear limitations.
uc6Body: Give teams a consistent report format.
freeFeature: 3 reports per month · All research modes · Copy, Markdown, and PDF export
proFeature: 15 reports per month · All research modes · Copy, Markdown, and PDF export · Email support
enterpriseFeature: Custom report volume · API access · Tailored onboarding
payNote: Paid plans are not self-serve yet. Contact us to sign up. Free limits reset on the 1st of each month.
priv1: Your question, any attached text, and your options are sent to an AI provider to write the report.
priv2: VerifAI does not save your questions or reports on its servers. Reports stay in your browser until you close or refresh the page.
priv3: Don't include personal or confidential information. There are no accounts yet, and your free-report count is stored only in your browser.
a1: The AI breaks your topic into individual claims, compares what it knows from different sources, and labels each claim supported, disputed, or unverified. It is an aid to checking, not a guarantee.
a2: From the AI model's training knowledge. VerifAI does not search the live web, so links can be outdated or wrong. Open every source before relying on it.
q3: How long does a report take?
a3: Usually 20 to 60 seconds, depending on the topic and mode.
q4: Which languages and files are supported?
a4: Reports can be written in 19 languages. You can attach .txt or .md files up to 200 KB.
q5: How many reports can I create?
a5: 3 free reports per month, counted in your browser. Pro Researcher includes 15 per month.
a6: Yes. Copy the text, download it as Markdown, or use Print to save it as a PDF.
finalTitle: Turn your research into a report.
footerTag: Research with confidence. Report with clarity.
fallback: This language currently shows English content.
seoDescription: VerifAI turns questions and documents into AI-generated research reports with cited sources, claim-by-claim evidence labels, and clear limitations.
